scope.item: Conducting Technical cum Commercial Feasibility Study for installation of Lift at Poompuhar, Kodikkarai, Nagapattinam, Mallipattinam and Kilakkarai Lighthouses

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled/nationalised bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, valid three months from technical bid opening. Tender fee NIL.

period.completion: 60 Days from the date of award of contract
period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid licence/registration issued by State CEIG or other State/Central Government licensing authority for installation of lifts/elevators, with experience in similar works for Government/PSU/autonomous bodies
Average annual financial turnover at least 40% of estimated cost

Similar works completed in last seven years: three works each >= 40%, or two each >= 50%, or one >= 80% of estimated cost; similar work = technical cum commercial feasibility study for installation of elevators/lifts for multi-storeyed buildings/towers

OR reputed lift/elevator OEMs or authorised agencies with installation experience in multi-storeyed buildings/towers for Government/PSU bodies: one work >= Rs 35.00 lakh, or two works each >= Rs 22.00 lakh, or three works each >= Rs 18.00 lakh
Only completed works with completion certificate; experience certificate from officer not below Executive Engineer
PAN/ITCC/GST registration; key technical personnel details
Unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure III), tender acceptance letter (Annexure II), not-blacklisted affidavit, list of relatives serving in MoPSW/DGLL
notes: NIT dated 07/08/2024; two-cover online bids; download and submission 08.08.2024 18:00 to 29.08.2024 15:00, opening 30.08.2024 15:00.
